css: .auth-page{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;background:#F5F7FA;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans SC','Segoe UI',sans-serif;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.auth-bg-decor{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}.decor-circle{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;opacity:0.04}.decor-1{width:600px;height:600px;background:#0F3460;top:-200px;right:-150px}.decor-2{width:400px;height:400px;background:#C91F37;bottom:-150px;left:-100px}.decor-3{width:250px;height:250px;background:#0F3460;top:50%;left:60%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.auth-container{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;width:960px;max-width:96vw;min-height:600px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(15,52,96,0.15),0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)}.auth-brand-panel{flex:0 0 420px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0F3460 0%,#0a2340 40%,#0d2848 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.auth-form-panel{flex:1;background:#ffffff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:40px}.form-card{width:100%;max-width:380px}.tab-switcher{display:flex;position:relative;background:#F5F7FA;border-radius:12px;padding:4px;margin-bottom:24px}.tab-btn{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 16px;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#8899aa;cursor:pointer;border-radius:10px;transition:all 0.3s ease;position:relative;z-index:1}.tab-btn.active{color:#C91F37}.tab-indicator{position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;width:calc(50% - 4px);height:calc(100% - 8px);background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;transition:transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);z-index:0}.tab-indicator.right{transform:translateX(100%)}.form-message{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:16px}.form-message.error{background:#fef2f2;color:#dc2626;border:1px solid #fecaca}.form-message.success{background:#f0fdf4;color:#16a34a;border:1px solid #bbf7d0}.login-mode-tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;margin-bottom:20px;font-size:13px}.mode-tab{cursor:pointer;color:#8899aa;padding:4px 8px;transition:color 0.3s}.mode-tab.active{color:#C91F37;font-weight:600}.mode-divider{color:#d1d5db}.input-group{display:flex;align-items:center;background:#F5F7FA;border-radius:10px;padding:0 12px;margin-bottom:14px;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:all 0.3s ease}.input-group:focus-within{border-color:#0F3460;background:#ffffff}.form-input{flex:1;padding:12px 8px;border:none;outline:none;background:transparent;font-size:14px;color:#1a2b5f}.form-input::placeholder{color:#aab2c8}.sms-btn{padding:8px 14px;border:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#C91F37,#e8384f);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:all 0.3s}.sms-btn:disabled{background:#cccccc;cursor:not-allowed}.submit-btn{width:100%;padding:14px;border:none;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0F3460,#1a4a8a);color:#ffffff;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transition:all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(15,52,96,0.25)}.submit-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,52,96,0.35)}.submit-btn:active{transform:scale(0.97)}.submit-btn:disabled{opacity:0.6;cursor:not-allowed}.role-selector{margin-bottom:14px}.role-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13px;color:#8899aa;margin-bottom:8px}.role-options{display:flex;gap:10px}.role-option{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 8px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid #e5e7eb;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s ease;background:#ffffff}.role-option.active{border-color:#C91F37;background:#fef5f6}.brand-inner{text-align:center;padding:40px 30px;position:relative;z-index:1}.brand-badge{width:64px;height:64px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 20px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)}.brand-title{font-size:32px;font-weight:900;color:#ffffff;letter-spacing:4px;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)}.brand-subtitle{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:2px}.brand-quote{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;margin:28px 0}.quote-line{width:40px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.3)}.quote-text{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:2px}.brand-features{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:28px}
